column1: # Modern-name candidates that have been READ, and what the reader concluded.
# A candidate absent from this file fails `--check`. Do not add a row you have not read: every row
# here is a claim that a human looked at that sentence and decided. Verdicts in use:
#   ok          Read, and the link is right. Most rows: a saint's basilica, a pope's own name, the
#               eleven lowercase "magi", "Lord Jesus Christ", "King Agrippa II".
#   book-title  Read, and the link is on a BOOK rather than a man. NOT fixed, because these are two
#               instances of a class of 119 across 42 shapes ("1 Samuel", "1-2 Peter", "the book of
#               Ruth", "the longer ending of Mark") that the app has only ever ruled on for "John",
#               and settling the rest touches authorship. Recorded so the ledger does not claim
#               they were read and found correct.
